content.text: *nitrofurantoin does not penetrate the kidney & is
▪︎bacterial infection of upper urinary tract (kidney, ureter)
: fever, chills, flank pain, CVA tenderness, N/V, weakness
: complicated, unable to tolerate PO ABX, hypovolemia, persistent N/V
(develops over several days) that radiates to ipsilateral flank, tenderness along
, low-grade fever, UTI SXS (dysuria, frequency, urgency)
: relief of pain w/ scrotal elevation
: enlarged hyperemic epididymis w/ ⇡ blood flow
: sudden onset of fever, N/V, & unilateral swollen/tender testicle
: symptomatic (NSAIDs, rest, scrotal support, cool packs)
▪︎most common in young, sexually active men
▪︎avoid sexual activity x1wk after TX initiation
